parameters.content:
## Care Plan Request → office email

Called by POST /api/care-plan-request on the Cloudflare Pages intake project, via
context.waitUntil() with a ~4s timeout. The customer's submission is ALREADY saved
in D1 before this runs, so a failure here delays the office email — it never loses
the lead. Check the Cloudflare Function logs for
"office notification failed for id=NNN" if an email goes missing.

### Auth
Header Auth credential: name `X-Webhook-Secret`, value = the same string stored as
the `N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET` secret on the Pages project.

### Payload contract (JSON body)
```
{
  submissionId:     1234,                      // D1 submissions.id
  submissionNumber: "#1234",                    // zero-padded, matches the dashboard
  submittedAt:      "2026-09-23T18:04:11.000Z", // server-side ISO, never the client's
  dashboardUrl:     "https://care-plan-builder.pages.dev",
  customer: { name, phone, address, bestTime },  // bestTime: Morning | Midday |
                                                 // Afternoon | Evening | Anytime |
                                                 // "No preference"
  plan:     { id, name, basePrice },             // name is server-derived from id
  addons: [ {
    id, name, unitPrice, quantity, lineTotal,
    includedFree,   // true  = complimentary with the plan ($0)
    locked,         // true  = left over from a plan the customer switched away
                    //         from; kept so the office isn't blind to it, $0
    billable        // true  = counted in totals.addonTotal
  } ],
  totals:   { basePrice, addonTotal, total, monthlyEquivalent }
}
```
Every price is recomputed server-side from lib/intake/catalog.js. Nothing in this
payload is taken from the browser.
